applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic NZ$15,000 tuition discount rather than a competitive scholarship: you apply only for admission to one of fifteen named bachelor's degrees and, if admitted, the grant appears on your Offer of Place. It reduces first-year tuition only, so years two and three of the degree remain your own cost. The terms quietly exclude Australian and New Zealand citizens and permanent residents despite the page's 'any region' wording, and you must start in Semester 1 or 2 2027 - deferring to 2028 forfeits the grant entirely.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International school leavers or transfer students with their heart set on a listed Massey bachelor's degree who can self-fund NZ living costs and want a discount with zero application effort.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your exact degree against the fifteen-name eligible list before you apply - an unlisted bachelor's degree receives nothing from this grant and is instead directed to the Toroa International Undergraduate Fee Scholarship.
Get your admission application complete by 31 October 2026 for a Semester 1 2027 start; after that date applications are only considered if spaces remain.
Book an accepted English test early - scores are valid for two years and undergraduate entry requires IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5.
Line up officially verified passport or birth-certificate copies, your high school certificate, and transcripts translated into English showing the grading scale.
Do not plan around stacking this grant with another Massey scholarship - the terms forbid combining it with any other University scholarship or fee reduction.
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a bachelor's degree that is not on the eligible list - the single most common way applicants miss out.
Holding Australian or New Zealand citizenship or permanent residency, or arriving via a partner TNE/articulation programme or recognition of prior learning - all explicitly excluded by the terms.
Deferring an offer or starting in 2028, which falls outside the 2027 commencement window.
Dropping below 120 credits or switching programmes mid-year, which can reduce, withdraw or prorate the grant.
Holding a fully funded government scholarship such as Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki or TSLS.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation, insurance and flights are wholly uncovered, as is any tuition above NZ$15,000 and all tuition from year two onward.
document_audit: A drivers licence cannot be used to confirm identity or citizenship - use a passport or birth certificate.
Overseas transcripts need an English translation and the grading scale, and provisional results or exam notifications are not accepted.
English test scores older than two years are invalid, and failing one IELTS band normally forces a full resit unless you use the 90-day one-skill retake.
Massey can request officially verified hard copies after you apply, so keep originals accessible.
If your passport and transcripts show different surnames, include marriage or deed-poll evidence linking the names.
alerts: The 31 October 2026 Semester 1 due date for new international students is only weeks away, and late applications depend on leftover spaces.
Withdrawing before the census date can cancel the grant outright.

Selected-entry dates differ for eligible degrees: Bachelor of Nursing closes 31 January 2027 (Semester 1 only) and Bachelor of Aviation closes 30 October 2026 (Semester 1) / 30 April 2027 (Semester 2) for international students.
The grant is a fee reduction, not cash - it never reaches your bank account, so it does nothing for rent, food or airfares.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the admission application online and watch the student portal - eligibility is decided on the Offer of Place and the tuition reduction is confirmed there, with no scholarship form at any point.

applicant_utility.summary: The postgraduate version is an automatic NZ$10,000 tuition reduction applied at admission to one of twenty-one listed Massey master's degrees starting in Semester 1 or 2 2027. There is no application to write, but the eligible list is short and coursework-heavy, and four of the listed creative-arts master's degrees close for Semester 1 on 29 November 2026. It trims one year of tuition only, and the postgraduate English bar (IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0) is stricter than the undergraduate standard.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students entering a listed coursework master's degree at Massey who can fund living costs themselves and prefer a guaranteed discount over a competitive scholarship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your master's degree is on the twenty-one-name eligible list before applying - several well-known Massey postgraduate programmes are absent, and unlisted degrees are routed to the Toroa International Postgraduate Fee Scholarship instead.

For Master of Design, Fine Arts, Screen Arts or Commercial Music, work to the 29 November 2026 Semester 1 selected-entry deadline; for other listed degrees the new-international date is 31 October 2026.
Prepare for the higher postgraduate English standard: IELTS 6.5 overall with no band under 6.0 (PTE 58 with 50 in each skill), with test scores under two years old.
Have translated tertiary transcripts showing the grading scale ready - postgraduate admission is assessed on prior degree study, not school results.
Treat the grant as first-year support only and evidence funding for the remainder of the programme for your visa and fee payments.
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a master's degree that is not on the twenty-one-name eligible list.
Holding Australian or New Zealand citizenship or permanent residency, or entering through a partner TNE/articulation programme or recognition of prior learning - all excluded by the terms.
Missing the 29 November 2026 selected-entry deadline for the creative-arts master's degrees.
Applying to the Executive MBA as an international student - the 2027 due-date table lists no international application date for that qualification.
Dropping below 120 credits or changing programmes mid-year, which can reduce, withdraw or prorate the grant.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation, insurance and travel, plus any tuition above NZ$10,000 and all tuition beyond the grant year, including the second year of a two-year master's.
document_audit: Postgraduate admission runs on tertiary transcripts - a high school certificate alone will not satisfy the entry requirement.
The Executive MBA's 2027 Semester 1 due date appears as domestic-only, so international EMBA applicants should email International Recruitment before relying on this grant.
English scores must be less than two years old, and postgraduate entry needs the higher 6.5/6.0 IELTS profile rather than the undergraduate 6.0.
Massey can request officially verified hard copies after you apply, so keep originals accessible.
Evidence of any scholarship you already hold must be supplied at admission, and this grant cannot be combined with other Massey scholarships or fee reductions.
alerts: The standard 31 October 2026 Semester 1 international deadline is imminent, and late applications are only considered if spaces remain.
Semester 2 starters are covered across Semester 2 2027 and Semester 1 2028 - a single grant year that straddles two calendar years.
Withdrawing before the census date can cancel the grant outright.
Despite the page's 'from any region' wording, the terms exclude Australian and New Zealand citizens and permanent residents.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for admission to a listed master's degree online; the university confirms eligibility on the Offer of Place, where the NZ$10,000 tuition reduction appears - no scholarship form is required.
